name: rever-ui-cloner
title: Rever
description: 40 website-intelligence tools for agents. 20 free calls/day on most tools, then $0.001 to $0.05 per call (x402, USDC on Base): page to markdown, contacts, socials, SEO and security audits, DNS, WHOIS, tech stack, crypto project trust check, design tokens, screenshots, UI-recreation prompts.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists all tools with prices.

tools.name: clone_ui
tools.description: Turn any public website URL into a detailed prompt (layout, components, colors, typography, spacing) for recreating its UI with a code model such as Lovable, v0, Claude or Cursor ($0.05)

tools.name: design_tokens
tools.description: Extract a website's design tokens as JSON ($0.02)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot any public web page ($0.01)

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect the technologies behind a website ($0.005)

tools.name: brand_kit
tools.description: Get a website's brand kit in one call ($0.01)

tools.name: page_markdown
tools.description: Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs ($0.003)

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Get a page's metadata ($0.002)

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Extract contact details from a web page ($0.003)

tools.name: social_links
tools.description: Find a website's social media profiles ($0.002)

tools.name: links
tools.description: List every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with nofollow flags and the external domains linked to ($0.002)

tools.name: broken_links
tools.description: Check the links on a web page for broken ones ($0.005)

tools.name: sitemap
tools.description: Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps ($0.003)

tools.name: robots
tools.description: Read and parse a website's robots.txt ($0.002)

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Grade a website's HTTP security headers (A-F) ($0.002)

tools.name: https_check
tools.description: Check a site's HTTPS setup ($0.002)

tools.name: redirects
tools.description: Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10) ($0.002)

tools.name: headers
tools.description: Get the raw HTTP response headers of any URL, with status code, final URL after redirects and response time ($0.001)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Is this website up? Returns up/down, HTTP status, response time in ms, final URL and content type ($0.001)

tools.name: language
tools.description: Detect a web page's language ($0.001)

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Text statistics for a web page's visible content ($0.002)

tools.name: structured_data
tools.description: Extract all structured data from a web page ($0.003)

tools.name: og_image
tools.description: Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared) ($0.001)

tools.name: feeds
tools.description: Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml) and return the latest items from the first one ($0.003)

tools.name: images
tools.description: List the images on a web page with absolute URL, alt text, declared width/height and lazy-loading, plus counts of images missing alt text (accessibility/SEO) ($0.002)

tools.name: headings
tools.description: Get the heading outline of a web page (H1-H6 in document order) with counts per level and structure warnings (no H1, several H1s, skipped levels) ($0.001)

tools.name: seo_audit
tools.description: Quick on-page SEO audit with a 0-100 score ($0.005)

tools.name: favicon
tools.description: Get the best favicon/icon for a website ($0.001)

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS lookup for a website's domain ($0.002)

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: Check a domain's email setup and spoofing protection ($0.003)

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS) ($0.003)

tools.name: ai_readiness
tools.description: How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, whether content renders without JavaScript, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 manifests, with a 0-100 score and fixes ($0.003)

tools.name: page_text
tools.description: Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normalized, with title and word count ($0.002)

tools.name: forms
tools.description: List the forms on a web page ($0.002)

tools.name: trackers
tools.description: Detect analytics, ad and tracking scripts on a web page (Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar, Clarity, Segment, Mixpanel, HubSpot, Plausible...), cookie-consent tools and all third-party script domains ($0.003)

tools.name: company_info
tools.description: Company profile from its website in one call ($0.005)

tools.name: key_pages
tools.description: Find the important pages of a website from its home page links ($0.002)

tools.name: page_weight
tools.description: Page performance basics without a browser ($0.002)

tools.name: wayback
tools.description: Internet Archive history of a website ($0.002)

tools.name: crypto_site_check
tools.description: Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact ($0.02)
